name: drrl
source: Wang et al., Advancing Loss Functions in Recommender Systems: A Comparative Study with a Renyi Divergence-Based Solution, AAAI 2025; github.com/cynthia-shengjia/AAAI-2025-DrRL @ faacdbc (optimizer/optim_DrRL.py, model/model_MF.py and model_LightGCN.py with norm_emb 1, tools/procedure.py Train)
grid_source: The paper's Table 8 settings for its 12 (dataset, backbone) cases: gamma (renyi_omega) 1.08 to 1.27 (most 1.15 to 1.25), beta0 (renyi_margin) 0.70 to 0.90 (most 0.85 to 0.90), margin learning rate 1e-4 in 6 of 12 cases and 1e-5 in the rest (fixed here at 1e-4), learning rate 1e-5 to 1e-1 per case. 8-trial budget: lr_mult {1, 10} x gamma {1.1, 1.2} x beta0 {0.8, 0.9}. lr_mult multiplies the plain model's tuned learning rate (1 = the plain setting is always a candidate), so the same pick transfers to MF. The appendix ranges were not in our copy of the paper; the grid is read from the Table 8 values and is recorded as our choice.
memory: plain LightGCN/MF plus 1024 negatives per positive (2048 x 1024 x 64 floats = 0.5 GB per batch) and one margin per user (n_users floats)
